residualRisks: The NativeChildHandle duck-type accepts a structurally compatible handle but a malicious injected transport could craft a non-child-process object; mitigated by the seam being @internal.
The injected transport validates cwd/env/stdio at the interface level only; a fake transport not exercising shell expansion can not test native-plugin's shell:false guarantee.
8 surviving Stryker mutants in native-plugin.ts are equivalent-to-context (waitForExit/timer cleanup and error-listener no-ops) and do not represent meaningful coverage gaps.
